-- Create enum for change request status
DO $$ BEGIN
    CREATE TYPE change_request_status AS ENUM ('pending', 'processing', 'preview', 'applied', 'rejected', 'rolled_back');
EXCEPTION
    WHEN duplicate_object THEN null;
END $$;

-- Create change_requests table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS change_requests (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    business_process_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES business_processes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    status change_request_status DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
    request_text TEXT NOT NULL,
    request_type VARCHAR(50),
    target_step_id VARCHAR(100),
    proposed_changes TEXT,
    changes_summary TEXT,
    progress INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    progress_message VARCHAR(255),
    previous_version_id INTEGER,
    new_version_id INTEGER,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL,
    applied_at TIMESTAMP,
    rolled_back_at TIMESTAMP
);

-- Create process_versions table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS process_versions (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    business_process_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES business_processes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    version_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
    title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    stages TEXT,
    roles TEXT,
    steps TEXT,
    branches TEXT,
    documents TEXT,
    it_integration TEXT,
    diagram_data TEXT,
    stage_details TEXT,
    total_time INTEGER,
    total_cost INTEGER,
    change_request_id INTEGER,
    change_summary TEXT,
    created_by_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL
);
